facts.fact: Ministry of ICT page says Nairobi and 28 counties were connected to the Kenya National Optical Fiber Backbone Infrastructure (NOFBI) in phase I, 2012-2013.
Ministry of ICT page says the remaining 18 counties and 3 towns were connected in phase 2, completed 2017, giving all 47 counties a NOFBI connection.
